category_seo.title: Crypto Influencers & KOLs - Web3 Content Creators | BiuBiu Tools
category_seo.description: Discover crypto influencers and content creators. Follow key opinion leaders, analysts, and builders on social media.

faqs.question: How do I find reliable crypto influencers?
faqs.answer: Look for builders who share knowledge, not just price predictions. Check track records, transparency about holdings, and quality of analysis. Avoid pure shillers.

faqs.question: What platforms do crypto KOLs use?
faqs.answer: Twitter/X is the main hub. YouTube for long-form. Farcaster for Web3 native. Substack/Mirror for newsletters. TikTok for mainstream reach.

faqs.question: Should I follow trading signals?
faqs.answer: Be very cautious. Many 'signals' are paid promotions or pump-and-dumps. Influencers often sell their bags to followers. Focus on education over trading calls.
